name: Kunwar Bai Nu Mameru Yojana Gujarat
benefit: Financial assistance of ₹12,000/- per couple is provided during the marriage.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a native of the Gujarat. 1. The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Tribe. 1. The applicant's annual family income must not exceed ₹6,00,000/-. 1. The benefits under this scheme are eligible for till the occasion of the marriage of two (2) adult girls of the family. 1. The bride's age must be 18 years at the time of marriage. 1. The groom's age must be 21 years at the time of marriage.
